items.alt_text: Scatter plot of y versus x with a rising line of best fit showing a positive trend and one distinct low outlier at about x equals 6.
items.long_description: This is a scatter plot with a straight line of best fit on a pale yellow background. There is no title inside the figure itself; the caption outside is Figure 12.32. The horizontal axis is labeled "x" with tick marks labeled 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, and 14, and the axis extends from 0 to about 15. The vertical axis is labeled "y" with tick marks labeled 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100, and the axis extends from 0 at the bottom to just above 100 at the top; the plotted area and the line of best fit continue slightly above the 100 tick to about 103 to 105 for the line, without an additional labeled tick at 105. The data are shown as small solid blue circles. There are 11 points, each read as about: at x about 0, y about 68; at x about 1, y about 69; at x about 2, y about 77; at x about 3, y about 79; at x about 4, y about 84; at x about 5, y about 86; at x about 6, y about 58; at x about 7, y about 89; at x about 8, y about 90; at x about 9, y about 95; and at x about 10, y about 96. The straight dark-colored line of best fit has a gentle positive slope, starting near (x about 0, y about 71) at the left edge and rising to about (x about 15, y about 103) at the right edge, passing slightly below most of the points. Overall, as x increases y tends to increase, with 10 points forming a fairly tight upward band close to the line, while the single point at about (6, 58) lies well below the line and well below the surrounding points, appearing as a low outlier.
